name: Sea Creature Bones
summary: On Darkshore, Sea Creature Bones come from massive marine carcasses washed ashore. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde gathers skeletal samples for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus, where the cause of the strandings is under investigation.

sections.title: A Portent on the Shore
sections.body: Massive sea creatures have begun flinging themselves onto Darkshore’s shallows, where they perish. Among them are giant threshers far larger than those native to the local waters. Night elves see the sudden increase as an ominous portent. Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, sent by the Temple of the Moon to Auberdine, gathers bones from the beached creatures. Hippogryphs carry the specimens to Darnassus for close examination.

sections.title: Carrion and Scavengers
sections.body: The immense carcasses attract local scavengers. Greymist murlocs gather around the dead and dying creatures, feeding on their remains and fiercely defending the feeding grounds. The murlocs are too weak to hunt beasts of this size, but investigators and adventurers must fight through their packs along Mist's Edge to recover bone fragments for study.

faq.q: Why are these creatures washing ashore?
faq.answer: The exact cause remains unknown. Occasional strandings are a natural hazard, but the sudden, dramatic increase is considered unnatural and alarming by the priestesses of Elune, who have begun a formal investigation.

aliases: who turns in sea creature bones
faq.answer: Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde, an investigator stationed in Auberdine, gathers the bones for the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. Scholars and priestesses there hope to learn what is disturbing the sea.

faq.q: Did the murlocs kill these giant beasts?
faq.answer: No. The Greymist murlocs are too weak to bring down marine beasts of that size. They gather in numbers to feed on the carcasses after the creatures wash ashore.

faq.q: Where are the bones recovered from?
aliases: where to find sea creature bones
faq.answer: The bones come from massive carcasses stranded along Darkshore’s shore, especially on the sands south of Auberdine and along Mist's Edge.

angles.text: The sudden mass strandings deeply disturb the night elves, who revere harmony in the natural world. They see the beachings as a dark omen that requires the Temple of the Moon’s attention.
The inexplicable deaths of ancient marine predators signal a deep disturbance in the waters off Kalimdor. This troubles any guardian devoted to ecological balance.
